rv.q: All big questions and all beautifully addressed in this often quite humorous and decidedly unconventional psychological thriller.
Anyone looking for a play both thought-provoking and passionate should see Kairos.
Lisa Sanaye Dring’s play “Kairos,” which just opened at The Edge Off Broadway theater, is one of the most thought-provoking and enjoyable productions I have seen lately.
Lisa Sanaye Dring’s Kairos , directed by Clare Brennan, is winsomely presented in Red Theater’s production, with naturalistic performances by Glaser and Washington.

cn.t: This thought-provoking sci-fi romance explores immortality through a couple's domestic struggle with synthetic life extension. Critics praise the timely premise and strong performances in Dring's engaging 90-minute play.
